scope: Each native runner builds from the committed source, verifies the official runtime checksum, archives and extracts the package, then tests using its bundled Node runtime with no Node on PATH. Native launcher execution checks Unix executable permissions. All eight package checks and nine portable/staging unit cases pass; 251 contracts pass on every runner. Network routes outside loopback are blocked during browser checks.
journey: The complete recorded-voice journey passes on local Windows; see windows-portable.json. Full native gameplay and performance acceptance on all four hosted platforms is not claimed.

priorAttempts.finding: Intel Mac microphone initialization exceeded the former five-second test wait; thirty-second initialization wait passes on subsequent runs. Windows full journey stalled the existing movement assertion.
All eight Windows archive checks passed; the additional full journey stalled movement. Linux and both Macs passed the archive checks.
